data.name: Jamil
data.gender_notes: Jamil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jamil is derived from the Arabic word 'jamila' which means beautiful, handsome, and elegant. In Islamic tradition, Jamil is considered to be a name of God, representing His beauty and grace. The name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Mulk, where God is described as 'Al-Jameel' – The Beautiful One. The name Jamil carries the meaning “Beautiful, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jamil usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jamil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, Handsome.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamil total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
